title: Autogenerated incident storyboards from trace and metric signals
creator: Sana Patel
description: Create a service and pipeline that automatically generates an "incident storyboard" artifact for analytics pipeline incidents. The storyboard should stitch together the minimal set of traces, relevant SLI/SLO windows, high-cardinality logs, and a short timeline with correlated metric anomalies. The goal is to reduce time-to-context for on-call and incident reviews by providing a one-click narrative and visual snapshot for the top correlated signals across Console backend services and analytics ingest paths.
motivation: On-call engineers currently spend 15-45 minutes gathering traces, logs, and dashboard slices before making an initial decision. For analytics pipeline incidents (ingest backpressure, KV cache storms, catastrophic sampling misconfigurations) we can substantially reduce toil and mean time to mitigation by surfacing a pre-curated, prioritized storyboard.
acceptance_criteria: When an alert fires for a designated analytics SLO (ingest-latency or ingest-error-rate), the system generates a storyboard in <5 minutes that includes: a short timeline (1-3 annotated events), 3 representative traces, the SLI timeseries with the SLO window highlighted, and links to related high-cardinality logs.
Storyboards are stored in the incident-store with a stable URL attached to the alert and to the incident timeline in the Console UI.
On-call can add notes and mark which traces were root-cause candidates; those selections persist and populate an incident summary for postmortems.
Generated artifact size and retention are bounded to keep per-incident cost under the defined budget (configurable per project).
Integration with PagerDuty: alerts include storyboard URL; playbooks link back to the generated artifact.
End-to-end tests added to CI that simulate a synthetic ingest-pressure incident and validate storyboard generation latency and content completeness.
A small audit log of generated storyboards is available for compliance (who viewed/annotated).
tasks: Design storyboard schema: timeline entries, trace selectors, SLI-context window, log snippets, root-cause tags
Instrument alert hook to call storyboard-generator lambda/service
Implement trace selector heuristics (error-first, span-duration, increased op-count) and fallbacks when traces are sparse
Add SLI snapshot exporter to package the last 60/180/600s of metric series around the alert
Create storage + retention policy (compressed JSON + pointers to raw traces/logs), add size budgeting
Console UI: preview pane in incident timeline with expand-to-full-storyboard view
PagerDuty and incident service integration: include stable URL in PD payloads
Add CI synthetic test and load test for generation under peak telemetry ingestion
design_decisions: Use an event-driven generator (K8s Job + small service) rather than synchronous alert-hook to keep alerting latency bounded
Persist storyboards in incident-store S3 bucket using a versioned key pattern: incidents/{incident_id}/storyboards/{timestamp}.json
Store only representative trace snippets (first/last 2k tokens compressed) and pointers to full traces to limit storage cost
Trace selector heuristic: prefer traces that contain top-N error spans, then fallback to longest-duration spans, then random sample within affected tenant
SLO windowing follows our established SLI contract: 60s short, 10m medium, 1h long; all three included for context
Authentication: storyboard URLs require Console session token or short-lived signed URL for PD integrations
Retention default: 30 days for auto storyboards, 90 days for manual-saved storyboards (configurable per-tenant)
Audit trail recorded to audit-log-stream for compliance and postmortem queries
implementation_notes: We will reuse existing trace-compactification helpers from ENG-45123 to compress selected spans
Metric snapshot exporter can piggyback on existing metric-query endpoint used by synthetic probes (ENG-67891)
Need a light-weight html+json renderer for the Console preview pane; propose a server-side pre-render to avoid client CPU spikes
Add a feature flag 'storyboards.enabled' per-org for staged rollout
Ensure generator respects tenant data-privacy settings and PII redaction that the logging pipeline enforces
risks_and_mitigations: Large bursts of incidents could cause significant storyboard generation CPU: mitigate via queue rate-limits and golden-path sampling
Storyboards could expose sensitive log snippets: respect log redaction filters and run a regex PII scrub before persistence
Incorrect trace selection could bias responders: surface heuristic metadata (why traces were chosen) and allow manual override
Cost growth if naive retention used: enforce size caps and require manual promotion for longer retention
